brief: I need an assistant that answers HR policy questions for our shore staff (office employees, not crew at sea). It should explain leave entitlements, how to apply for leave, travel and expense claims, and working-from-home rules. It should also be able to tell people their salary band and when payroll is processed. Keep it friendly and short, and it must never give legal or medical advice.

groundability.evidence: Permanent shore staff are entitled to 18 working days of paid annual leave per calendar year.
groundability.reason: The document explicitly details annual leave, sick leave, casual leave, and parental leave entitlements for shore staff.

groundability.evidence: All leave is applied for through the HR portal "PeopleDesk". Annual leave of more than 3 days must be applied for at least 14 days in advance.
groundability.reason: The document provides clear instructions on the application process, required advance notice, and approval timelines.

groundability.evidence: Expense claims must be submitted in PeopleDesk within 30 days of returning from the trip, with original receipts for every item above INR 500.
groundability.reason: The document details pre-approval, travel classes, per diems, and the expense claim reimbursement process.

groundability.evidence: Eligible employees may work from home up to 2 days per week. Tuesday and Thursday are mandatory office days for all teams
groundability.reason: The document covers eligibility, hybrid schedules, core collaboration hours, equipment, allowances, and data security rules.
None of the provided documents mention salary bands or compensation structures.
The documents mention payroll cycles in the context of expense reimbursements, but do not contain information about payroll processing dates.
